QuestInfo.name: The Ancient Spirit
QuestInfo.0: You're finally Lv. 30, but you still can't seem to use most of your old skills. There must be a way to get them back...
QuestInfo.1: In the past, you would seek out the wisdom of the #b#p1033210##k when it came time to learn new skills. You already know the skills, but you still aren't strong enough to use them. Try awakening the #p1033210# from her resting place in #b#m101050000#'s#k #b#m101050010##k.

0.0: I feel much stronger now. Why don't I try using my 2nd Advancement Skills? Okay, here goes! Huh? It didn't work... I'll try again! HI-YAH! ...Nothing...
0.1: Hm. When I first became ruler of the Elves, I had to pass a test from the #p1033210# of the Elves. Now that I'm starting over, do I have to do that again?
0.2: There were 3 trials I had to pass, wasn't there? For that last trial, I had to beat the Rage Dragon. That creature almost eliminated me, instead...
0.3: I don't think I could beat it the way I am now. Maybe if I tell the #p1033210# that I remember the skills, and am just not strong enough to use them, she'll understand... Or maybe she'll tell me I'm not worthy of Elven Grace anymore.
0.4: No sense putting it off! I'll go see #p1033210#, and whatever happens, happens. Perhaps it is time for a new ruler of the Elves, after all.\r\n#b#e(You will be moved to Elluel if you accept.)#n#k

yes.0: All right then! I need to go back to my #m101050010# and #eplay#n that old song, The Sovereign's Appeal. It's been a long time, but I practiced the Appeal hundreds of times. I'm sure I can play it still.

no.0: I'm worrying myself over nothing! I'm sure if I just train a little more, I'll get my old skills back. Right...?

1.0: Hullo, Mercedes! You're lookin' right good, you are! So, what can I do for you? I already gave you all the power I can, deary!
